intro.text: A burglar in Camon's thieving crew in Luthadel.

items.text: With the rest of the crew, then answering to Milev, told Vin the story of the Survivor of Hathsin just before Kelsier and his crew arrived at their safe house. He scoffed at Hrud's idea that Kelsier was more than a man. He then left with Milev's group, leaving Vin behind for the meeting.

appearance.text: An older man with a scraggly beard.
